analyst.summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers delivered a strong quarter with revenue up 41%, and profit and EBITDA growing even faster (52% and 57% respectively) - a genuine sign of improving efficiency, not just gold-price-driven revenue growth. Same-store sales grew 46%, among the strongest in this review. The company continues an aggressive store-expansion plan (from 78 to roughly 103 stores this fiscal year), which will require continued working-capital funding typical of the gold-jewellery retail business, but the underlying trend of profit outgrowing revenue is a genuinely encouraging quality-of-growth signal.
